_comment: Chat-free skilling: game-object id → resource token, an OPTIONAL accelerator for identifying the specific tree/rock when power-skilling (item dropped on a full inventory, so no itemId) AND the xp is a collision. Seeded EMPTY on purpose: RuneLite only reliably enumerates tree STUMPS, not live objects, so shipping guessed live-object ids would risk mis-mapping. Instead the plugin forwards the RAW clicked object id in the action tuple; anything the itemId/xp paths can't resolve is logged to skill_unmapped WITH its object id, which surfaces the real ids to add here (hot-reloaded, no restart, no plugin release). Format: {"<objectId>": "<token>"} e.g. {"1276": "normal", "10820": "oak"}. Verify each id against the targeted game revision before adding.
